description:
Get the link that lets the user connect a WhatsApp phone number in 360Dialog, plus what to tell them beforehand.

This hands over 360Dialog's own onboarding page. The user clicks
through Embedded Signup themselves; this tool cannot do it for them.

The user must be signed in to 360Dialog Hub already, or the link sends them to login first and loses
the destination. Tell them to make sure they're signed in first.

The link given by this tool may not work if the user's 360Dialog client account
is under a partner-paid channel. Make them aware of this.

Returns the client's current channel IDs for future reference on recognizing
which phone number was newly added.
name: start_number_onboarding
title: Start number onboarding
